raw_segments.text: What was their civilization? Vast, I allow, but vile. Cloakey, sewers. The Jews in the
wilderness and on the mountaintop said, It is meat to be here. Let us build an altar
to Jehovah. The Roman, like the Englishman who follows in his footsteps, brought to every
new shore on which he set his foot on our shore he never set it, only his cloacal obsession.
